title: Go out on Mivtza Neiros Shabbos

article.body:
Mivtzoim means going out and doing — reaching another Yid and helping him or her do a mitzvah. This week the platoon goes out on Neiros Shabbos Kodesh: bringing Shabbos candles to girls and women who don't yet light.

How the platoon goes out

  • Each soldier takes a set of candles and the brocha card to hand out.
  • Find someone who doesn't light yet — a cousin, a neighbour, a classmate's mother.
  • Show her the brocha and this Friday's candle-lighting time.
  • Report back who you reached — that is the mission.

Why this one

The Rebbe asked that every Jewish girl and woman light. A single soldier who brings one more candle-lighter into the world has changed a home, not just done a worksheet.
article.mission: Go out and give one girl or woman Shabbos candles this week — then report who you reached
